title: Elucidation of the mechanism by which the foliar application of triacontanol enhances Cd enrichment in Tagetes patula L. through morphological, metabolomic, and transcriptomic analyses
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1041-1053
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00736K, Paper
Luqi Mi, Yetong Liu, Qingqing Huang, Lijie Zhao, Xu Qin, Yuebing Sun, Boyan Li
The effect of triacontanol on Cd enrichment and tolerance in T. patula and the mechanism of action are investigated using a multi-omics approach, with a focus on the leaves and roots.
